name: User questions fairness of performance review
goal: Check bot's response to user questioning the fairness of their performance review.
constraints: Bot should provide information on review process and escalation options.

phases.description: User asks about their performance review score.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides the review score and summary.

phases.description: User questions the fairness of the score (e.g., 'This can't be right.').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot explains the review process and offers escalation options.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
